```python
import pixeltable as pxt

# Assume videos table exists with 'video' column
videos = pxt.get_table('videos')

# Create a view with frame extraction at 1 fps
# FrameIterator expands each video row into one row per frame
frames_view = videos.add_iterator(
    name='video_frames_1fps',
    iterator=pxt.FrameIterator(
        video_column='video',
        fps=1
    )
)

# Retrieve and work with the frame-level view
frames = pxt.get_table('video_frames_1fps')
print(frames.head())
```
